sloka: बहु मूल फलो रम्यो नाना नग समाकुलः ।तस्याम् वसति सुग्रीवः चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः ॥३-७३-४१॥
transliteration: bahu mūla phalo ramyo nānā naga samākulaḥ ।tasyām vasati sugrīvaḥ caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ ॥3-73-41॥

translations.english: Sugriva dwells in that cave with four other monkeys. At times he sits on the top of the mountain.
